Actual genitive article and God name jointly supply of God as the kingdom qualifier. The earlier actual cities case relation remains separately anchored.
The actual Greek aorist passive means I was sent; LSV uses perfect I have been sent. The same sending predicate and person remain linked with the tense/aspect wording difference explicit.

unmappedSource.reason: Greek introduces the quote with reporting ὅτι; English directly states it without a separate that.

4:44.sourceText: καὶ ἦν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς τῆς Ἰουδαίας.
4:44.targetText: and He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

groups.note: The actual εἰς introduces the synagogue domain of the preaching, rendered in the synagogues. The written Greek remains the accusative-governing εἰς, not an invented ἐν.

unmappedSource.reason: The whole actual genitive article/place phrase remains unpaired with the whole English of-Galilee phrase; a bare article-to-of link must not hide the different named region. The actual source spelling and both raw genitive tags remain unchanged. The actual N1904 regional name is Judea, Ἰουδαίας, while LSV names Galilee. The genuinely different named regions are not collapsed into a single location identity.
